user_query: I am organizing a fantasy cricket event for my friends and need to know the live matches currently happening. Additionally, fetch the top 20 players of the NBA playoffs in terms of total assists to create a leaderboard for the event.

TaskList.description: Fetch live cricket match information to know the currently happening matches.
Retrieve data of the top 20 NBA playoff players ranked by total assists.
Compile the data received from subtasks 1 and 2 to create the fantasy cricket leaderboard.
